text:
Type: white and birch three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes, toys and small items; children's room, bedroom, playroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: white painted fiberboard frame, birch-effect drawer fronts
Colors: white, light birch
Shape: compact boxy cabinet with two shallow drawers over one deep drawer, large rectangular cut-out grips at the top edge of each front, flat top, sits flat on the floor, low and squat
Feel: light, friendly, tidy, simple
Goes with: white walls, pale wood, colorful textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms or modern bedrooms

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
